newsitem.title: USA: HSBC group holds Quintiles stake.
newsitem.headline: HSBC group holds Quintiles stake.

text.p: A group including HSBC Holdings plc said on Monday it holds a 10.2 percent stake, or 3,417,385 common shares, in Quintiles Transnational Corp.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it received the shares in exchange for stock that it held in Innovex Ltd, a private British pharmaceutical company, which Quintiles acquired in a stock deal November 29.

The group said Quintiles has agreed to provide the Innovex shareholders registration rights for the shares they received. Quintiles exchanged about 9.2 million shares of its stock and issued options to buy about 800,000 shares in the deal.

Under the registration rights agreement, the group said Quintiles has agreed to file a registration statement for an underwritten public offering, planned for early 1997, to include up to 2.7 million Quintiles common shares.

Quintiles also agreed to file a shelf registration to allow the Innovex shareholders to register the Quintiles shares for resale in amounts not to exceed 500,000 shares in any 90-day period for about three years.
Quintiles also granted the Innovex shareholders "piggyback" rights to participate in underwritten offerings the Quintiles may register in the next three years.

Quintiles is a Research Triangle Park, N.C.,-based company that provides research, development and consulting services to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device and healthcare management industries.
The HSBC Group is among the world's largest banking and financial servics organisations.
